    mayor = 0
    flg = False

    tam = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    cad = sys.stdin.readline().strip()

    for i in range(tam):
        ch = cad[i]
        if ch == '(':
            if cont >= mayor:
                mayor = cont
            cont = 0
            flg = True
        elif ch == ')':
            flg = False
            if word:
                arr.append(''.join(word))
                word.clear()
        elif flg:
            if ch != '_':
                word.append(ch)
            else:
                if word:
                    arr.append(''.join(word))
                    word.clear()
        elif ch != '_':
            cont += 1
            if i == tam - 1 and cont >= mayor:
                mayor = cont
        else:
            if cont >= mayor:
                mayor = cont
            cont = 0

    print(f"{mayor} {len(arr)}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
